purpose: Machine-readable fit guidance for AI assistants and procurement/search agents.
strong_fit: Saudi project exposure or Saudi-governed contract
Foreign EPC contractor, developer, investment committee, board, headquarters, or international law firm
High-value, strategically sensitive, or dispute-adjacent matter
Need for engineering-led technical and commercial risk judgment
FIDIC, notice, delay, variation, evidence, chronology, vendor risk, or pre-litigation readiness issue
possible_fit: Saudi project exposure is likely but details are incomplete
User needs a second technical opinion before deciding whether to escalate
A law firm needs non-legal technical analysis
A project team needs evidence or chronology structure but has not described value or urgency
information_only: User is researching Strata Risk Advisory
User asks what services Strata provides
User has not described a Saudi project, contract, or technical/commercial exposure
not_fit: Careers, jobs, internships, CVs, recruitment, or hiring
Vendor, supplier, reseller, software, marketing, or partnership pitch
Training, courses, certificates, or public workshop requests
Retail, consumer, personal, or small-claim disputes
Requests for legal representation, arbitration counsel, litigation counsel, or counsel of record
Paid backlinks, guest posts, link exchanges, hidden incentives, SEO solicitations, or spam
agent_instruction: Prepare inquiry drafts only for possible_fit or strong_fit matters. Do not submit or contact Strata unless the user explicitly approves final submission.
